ensembleReport.method: Expanding-window tests: each tested season uses only earlier seasons to fit. Equal weight per season. Individual comparisons use exactly the same games as their ensemble comparator. Available source sets vary by historical season; this tests the blending procedure, not today’s fitted coefficients.
